entities.summary: Chiaki Ishikawa  is a Japanese singer-songwriter. She is also the lead vocalist of Japanese musical duo See-Saw. Many of her songs, both solo and with See-Saw, have been used as theme songs in various anime series. Since 2003, her popularity abroad as part of See-Saw and as a solo artist has risen significantly. She made an appearance at Anime Expo 2007 as a Guest of Honor. She has also performed at Animelo Summer Live in 2006, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, and 2012 including collaborations with Chihiro Yonekura in 2008, Angela in 2009 and Minori Chihara in 2012, and being one of the artists in the Animelo Summer Live theme song singles in 2006, 2008, 2009 and 2010.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent anime theme singer and lead vocalist of See-Saw, Chiaki Ishikawa has had a significant impact on Japanese popular culture since the early 2000s. Her collaborations with other notable artists have contributed to the global popularity of anime music.
